summary: The cause you carry out: Out of office, {the cause} still has your name on it, and {cause group} asks you to lead it.
realLife: One life: After leaving Congress she and her husband founded a gun-safety group in 2013, and she testified at a Senate hearing. Her husband won a U.S. Senate seat in 2020. Another: As the president's climate envoy from 2021 he negotiated a joint climate declaration with China. Separately, a leaked 2021 recording of Iran's foreign minister led senators to ask for an inquiry into what Kerry had told him. Another: After her 2022 loss she formed a political action committee, which ran ads urging her own party's primary voters not to back Trump.
